name: Synthetic enrichment verification case
label: events
description: Synthetic case built solely to exercise enrichment against live providers. Every observable is a public, non-sensitive value chosen for what it tests; none came from a real investigation.

notes.title: Why these
notes.content: Both readings exist as separate real domains. UTS #46 non-transitional gives xn--strae-oqa.de and xn--fa-hia.de; IDNA2003 transitional gives strasse.de and fass.de, which resolve elsewhere. A live answer therefore discriminates the two standards.

URL carrying credentials, an implied port and mixed case

notes.title: Why this
notes.content: The userinfo must never reach a provider or the cache. The host must be punycoded and the implied 443 dropped, while the path, query and fragment stay byte-for-byte.

notes.title: Why this
notes.content: The address itself must be recorded and never sent to any provider; only its domain part is looked up. RFC 5321 makes the local part case-sensitive, so only the domain half folds.

notes.title: Why this
notes.content: A well-known benign public resolver. Exercises RDAP and AbuseIPDB without disclosing anything sensitive.

notes.title: Why this
notes.content: Not globally routable, so no reputation provider should be contacted for it.
